narrative.intro: Barnard Construction recorded $5.9B in federal contract obligations for FY2026 to date. Barnard Construction won 12 awards so far, with an average award size of $490M, and obligations rose up 2967.6% year over year. Barnard Construction saw most activity this fiscal year in Commercial and Institutional Building Construction, which totaled $4.5B, and in Other Heavy and Civil Engineering Construction, which totaled $1.3B. Barnard Construction received the largest shares of obligations from the Department of Homeland Security, which obligated $4.5B, and from the Department of Defense, which obligated $1.3B. Fiscal-year history shows smaller earlier totals: FY25 at $192M, FY24 at $33.4M, FY23 at $4.1M, FY22 at $132M, and FY21 at $5.2M. Highway, Street, and Bridge Construction accounted for $500K and the Department of Agriculture accounted for $500K in FY2026 to date. Use these figures to understand Barnard Construction's fiscal concentration by agency and by market for FY2026 to date.

sections.heading: How concentrated are Barnard Construction's FY2026 obligations?
sections.body: Commercial and Institutional Building Construction is the largest market for Barnard Construction at $4.5B. Other Heavy and Civil Engineering Construction is the second market at $1.3B. Barnard Construction won 12 awards with an average award size of $490M, so a small number of large awards drive much of the total.

sections.heading: Who are Barnard Construction's top agency customers this fiscal year?
sections.body: The Department of Homeland Security is the top customer for Barnard Construction, with $4.5B in obligations. The Department of Defense is the second-largest customer for Barnard Construction, with $1.3B in obligations. The Department of Agriculture shows $500K in obligations to Barnard Construction.

faq.q: How much does Barnard Construction make from federal contracts?
faq.a: Barnard Construction made $5.9B from federal contracts in FY2026 to date. Barnard Construction won 12 awards this fiscal year with an average award size of $490M, and obligations rose up 2967.6% year over year.

faq.q: Which agencies buy from Barnard Construction?
faq.a: The Department of Homeland Security buys most from Barnard Construction. The Department of Homeland Security obligated $4.5B and the Department of Defense obligated $1.3B; the Department of Agriculture obligated $500K.

faq.q: What does Barnard Construction sell to the government?
faq.a: Barnard Construction sells construction services to the government. Commercial and Institutional Building Construction accounted for $4.5B and Other Heavy and Civil Engineering Construction accounted for $1.3B; Highway, Street, and Bridge Construction accounted for $500K.
